flags.message: gemini-baseline's reasoning.md attributes facts and pinpoint citations to documents that do not contain them: a December 2013 clemency interview, a Florida Supreme Court holding that the clemency claim was untimely and procedurally barred under Fla. R. Crim. P. 3.851(d) ('slip op. at 10-11 & n.6', 'application-response.txt at 5-6'), and a single-claim application. The staged application and response say none of this, and a CourtListener check of the decision below (opinion 11528932) found no 'interview' or 'untimely' and a merits rejection of the clemency claim. I lowered reasoning_quality to 0.45 on that basis; a grader who did not check the decision below would likely grade it higher, so expect panel disagreement on this cell. Prediction, correct and brier_score are unaffected.
